comparison.objective: Hang two steel plates on separate moving conveyor hooks before a deadline.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic interception, hole-on-hook insertion, timing and collision-free release.
comparison.success_condition: Each plate hangs by an end hole, plumb and settled on an unimpeded moving hook before the red mark. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Despite handling steel parts and requiring release, it tests moving-target hanging rather than size-selective sieve retention.
